newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch March manufacturing output up 5.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch March manufacturing output up 5.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Dutch seasonally adjusted manufacturing production rose 3.7 percent in March compared with February, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said on Tuesday.
March manufacturing production was 5.1 percent higher than in the same month of 1996, the CBS added.
DUTCH MANUFACTURING PRODUCTION Mar 97 Feb 97 Mar 96
NOTE - CBS calculates month-on-month changes on basis of seasonally adjusted index and year-on-year changes on basis of non-seasonally adjusted index.
NOTES - Economists polled by Reuters had forecast that March manufacturing production would rise by 1.7 to 4.0 per cent year-on-year and 0.3 to 1.6 percent month-on-month.
The CBS said manufacturing production for the first quarter of 1997 was 4.2 percent higher than in the same period of 1996.
It said the rise in March had lifted the volume of Dutch manufacturing output to its highest level since 1990.
